blockingFindings.title: Child diagnostics are ignored when the outer command exits 127
blockingFindings.issue: classifyFinalRegressionFailure returns DependencyRegressionFailure for result.exitCode === 127 before consulting preserved childProcesses. When the outer runner exits 127 but emitted typed child records with assertion, timeout, signal, or unknown nested failures, attribution is derived from the outer aggregate process instead of the preserved typed evidence.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Move child process classification before outer exit-code heuristics, or restrict the exitCode === 127 dependency classification to cases with no preserved child failure records. Update classifyFinalRegressionFailure to let classifyChildProcessFailure decide whenever childProcesses contains failures.
blockingFindings.rationale: R6 requires removing unsupported inference and deriving classification conservatively from preserved typed evidence. This branch bypasses typed child diagnostics and can misclassify a preserved nested failure as a dependency failure.
